# Rendered by giantswarm-platform-manager, agent-platform definition. Do not edit by hand:
# the next reconcile writes it again from the installation's inputs.
global:
  domain: ember.agentlab.test
components:
  kagent:
    enabled: true
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: kagent-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: oauth2-proxy.podAnnotations.kagent-credentials-revision
  agent-manager:
    enabled: true
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: podAnnotations.muster-credentials-revision
  muster:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: muster.oauth.server.existingSecretChecksum
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: muster.oauth.server.storage.valkey.existingSecretChecksum
  valkey:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: valkey.auth.usersExistingSecretChecksum
  model-manager:
    valuesFromRefs:
      - kind: Secret
        name: muster-credentials-revision
        valuesKey: revision
        targetPath: podAnnotations.muster-credentials-revision
postgres:
  enabled: true
llmRouting:
  enabled: true
kagent:
  providers:
    anthropic:
      apiKeySecretRef: kagent-anthropic-key
      config:
        baseUrl: http://agentgateway.agent-platform.svc:8081
        maxTokens: 32000
  oauth2-proxy:
    config:
      existingSecret: kagent-oauth2-proxy-credentials
    extraArgs:
      oidc-extra-audience: dex-k8s-authenticator,kagent,backstage # gitleaks:allow
muster:
  muster:
    oauth:
      server:
        existingSecret: muster-oauth-credentials
        storage:
          valkey:
            existingSecret: muster-valkey-credentials
        trustedAudiences:
          - dex-k8s-authenticator
          - kagent
          - backstage
gateway:
  jwksEgress:
    enabled: true
extraObjects:
  - apiVersion: gateway.networking.k8s.io/v1beta1
    kind: ReferenceGrant
    metadata:
      name: agentgateway-jwks-dex
      namespace: giantswarm
    spec:
      from:
        - group: agentgateway.dev
          kind: AgentgatewayPolicy
          namespace: agent-platform
      to:
        - group: ""
          kind: Service
          name: dex
agent-platform-mcps:
  agentgateway:
    jwt:
      extraProviders:
        - issuer: https://dex.ember.agentlab.test
          audiences:
            - backstage
          jwks:
            remote:
              backendRef:
                name: dex
                namespace: giantswarm
                port: 5556
              jwksPath: /keys
              cacheDuration: 5m
valkey:
  valkey:
    auth:
      usersExistingSecret: muster-valkey-credentials
      aclUsers:
        default:
          passwordKey: valkey-password
workspaces:
  enabled: true
workspace-manager:
  providers:
    instances:
      - name: github
        kind: github

# Rendered by giantswarm-platform-manager, agent-platform definition. Do not edit by hand:
# the next reconcile writes it again from the installation's inputs.
oidc:
  staticClients:
    muster:
      clientSecretRef:
        name: dex-client-muster
        key: secret
      extraRedirectURIs:
        - https://workspace-manager.ember.agentlab.test/signin
    mcpKubernetes:
      clientSecretRef:
        name: dex-client-mcp-kubernetes
        key: secret
    mcpPrometheus:
      clientSecretRef:
        name: dex-client-mcp-prometheus
        key: secret
    mcpCapi:
      clientSecretRef:
        name: dex-client-mcp-capi
        key: secret
    dexK8SAuthenticator:
      trustedPeers:
        - backstage
  extraStaticClients:
    - id: kagent
      name: kagent-ui
      secretRef:
        name: dex-client-kagent
        key: secret
      redirectURIs:
        - https://kagent.ember.agentlab.test/oauth2/callback
    - id: backstage
      name: Dev Portal
      redirectURIs:
        - https://portal.ember.agentlab.test/api/auth/oidc-ember/handler/frame
      secretRef:
        name: dex-client-backstage
        key: secret
